headline: PSX, JazzCash, and Next Capital Partner to Distribute Govt Sukuk
summary: Pakistan Stock Exchange, mobile wallet JazzCash, and brokerage Next Capital signed a pact to enable retail investors to purchase Government of Pakistan Sukuk through a digital mobile platform.
why: Retail access to sovereign Islamic bonds broadens domestic government borrowing channels and deepens financial inclusion in Pakistan.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Expanding digital distribution of sovereign Sukuk facilitates retail domestic debt mobilization.
